purpose: Upgrade the patched opencode 1.x binary to a newer upstream tag while re-applying our compaction-anchor fix, then verify the fix survived bundling before staging it for OpenChamber.
upstreamConstraint: v1.x only. NEVER target v2+: packages/opencode/ does not exist there and OpenChamber 1.24.2 requires OpenCode 1.x.

fix.title: Anchor the compaction summary to the marker message
markers: marker already carries a completed summary
fix.why: prompt.ts passed parentID: lastUser.id for the compaction summary, so a prompt landing in the marker-to-summary window orphaned the summary (infinite compaction) and discarded the marker's model (a plugin-supplied pin). Anchoring to the marker repairs both.

build.note: OPENCODE_VERSION must be set or the binary reports a dev version and free-tier models reject it with 426 'OpenCode 1.18.0 or newer is required'.

stage.note: Stable filename on purpose: opencodeBinary in OpenChamber settings.json points here forever, so an upgrade never requires editing settings again.

restartNote: OpenChamber must be fully closed and restarted to load a newly staged binary.
